page.overview:
What is Spore Blossom?

A spore blossom is a ceiling-hanging decorative block that emits green particles.

Spore blossoms can be found only on the ceiling of lush caves.

Spore blossoms can be broken instantly using any item or by hand. Harvesting a spore blossom using shears consumes the durability of the shears for no additional benefit.

Spore blossoms can be placed only on the underside of any block except for leaves.
